source.provenance: Firmware and APE images acquired from Lunars.

compatibility.modern_gui_control_id: Do not substitute 0x3FD for the recovered 0x3EE request transport.
compatibility.original_compact_profiles: Separate schema; not merged with archived bus profiles.

bit_numbering: Zero-based least-significant-bit first within the little-endian payload.
naming: All signal names in this profile are research labels, not claimed OEM schema names.

messages.label: request_input
messages.dlc_behavior: Decoder rejects lengths below8; length8 continues; above8 logs a diagnostic and continues. This is not exact-DLC validation.

evidence.verified: Input bit reaches RoadRunnerSignals payload +0x3d6, timestamped snapshot +0x3e6; update bitmap +0x30 bit34 gates callback. Both 0 and 1 overwrite.
evidence.unresolved: Actual rendering consumer and current-hardware equivalence.

evidence.verified: Input reaches callback packed state and, subject to receiver guards, accepted state +0x4cc; publication adds 0x10, yielding RoadRunnerSignals snapshot +0x4dc. Accepted state uses 0 unknown, 1 disabled, 2 enabled.
evidence.unresolved: This wire bit is a request, not an acknowledgement; receiver guards can suppress updates. Exact current-hardware acceptance is unknown.

evidence.verified: Input reaches packed +0x294e bit8, then RoadRunnerSignals payload +0x3c0 / snapshot +0x3d0; bitmap +0x30 bit44 gates callback.

evidence.unresolved: Normalized consumer and semantic identity; do not assign modern full-FSD semantics from bit position alone.

evidence.verified: State producer reads ASM snapshot +0x70 with additional inputs, translates it, and packs low four bits of 0x399. Recovered old helper does not emit 6.
evidence.unresolved: Exact old state names and modern enum equivalence.

evidence.verified: ASM snapshot +0x84 passes through numeric translation to payload bits32..38.
evidence.unresolved: Exact old enum names; this is not the HOLD reason at parent +0x558.

evidence.verified: Paired load reads ASM snapshot +0x74; 53-entry translation then packs payload bits46..52. Input12 maps to wire12; unsigned inputs above52 map to45.
evidence.unresolved: Old result12 meaning and modern semantic equivalence. This conditional diagnostic is not a request-receipt acknowledgement.

limits: Partial field inventory, not a complete message decoder.
No physical bus attribution, capture, runtime activation or HW4 compatibility is established.
Unknown message lengths remain null; field extraction requires sufficient bytes and a matching multiplexer.
No modern enum table has been copied into this older profile.
HOLD-related ASM snapshot +0x68 has no proven wire mapping and is intentionally not represented as a signal.
